products.title: J25 Hybrid Grip | Harbor | Links II Collection
products.body_html:
Control up Top. Comfort Down Low.

Designed for golfers who demand consistency in every condition. The J25 Hybrid combines a corded upper for stability and traction with a responsive rubber lower half for comfort and touch. This hybrid construction creates a confident, balanced feel through the swing—steady in the lead hand, relaxed in the trail. Available in Standard and Midsize +4 (modern taper). Quantity of 1 = 1 Grip.

products.body_html:

As an upgrade to the original TW97 Tour, we've combined a new high-tack texture pattern with a specialized tri-rubber compound to deliver maximum traction, durability, and responsive feel.

  • High-Tack Texture: For a secure, slip-free connection.
  • Tri-Rubber Compound: For season-long durability.
  • Tournament Grade: Engineered for the competitive edge.

 Available in Standard and Midsize. Quantity of 1 = 1 Grip.

products.title: TW97 Tour Grip | Redwood | Edgewood Collection
products.body_html:
The Modern Classic for Every Golfer.

The TW97 Tour Grips deliver a perfect balance of style, comfort, and control in every swing. Crafted from a responsive rubber compound and finished with a unique barbell-shaped texture, this grip offers dependable traction and a clean, timeless look. Available in both standard and medium sizes, the TW97 Tour is designed for golfers who want reliable performance and confident feel — without sacrificing style. Available in Standard and Midsize. Quantity of 1 = 1 Grip.
